title: KeenTouchstone Span
description: A single step in an agent run. OTel gen_ai.* canonical vocabulary + net-new harness.* fields. $id is a placeholder pending repo/domain.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id. THE join key across all artifacts.

parent_span_id.description: null for the root span of a run

input.messages.description: OPT-IN, privacy-gated. Oversized payloads stored by reference (content-addressed hash).

harness.step_id.description: NET-NEW. Monotonic per-run integer giving a deterministic linear replay order the span tree lacks.

harness.task_signature.description: NET-NEW. Task-identity key (SPEC section 5). Keystone for online pass^k: groups organic production runs into 'the same task'. Null until a TaskSignatureStrategy assigns one.

harness.agent_config_hash.description: NET-NEW. Hash of {prompts, tools, model params, scaffold version} = the harness identity. Used for reliability grouping and model-vs-harness A/B.

harness.replay.cassette_ref.description: NET-NEW. Pointer from a live span to its reproducing cassette event (run_id:step_id).

harness.nondeterminism_class.description: NET-NEW. First-class label of the non-determinism source, for replay.
